migration_note: REPLACE ~/0dte/controller_policy.json with this file, carrying over ONLY the account-identity fields from v4 (account number, starting_context). Everything the v4 file said about sizing dollars, CHOP=A+ only, 60-second SLAs, and raw social files is DELETED ON PURPOSE - see deleted_rules.

authority.single_execution_lane: EXACTLY ONE broker-capable lane: the 0dte-live-controller cron job. No interactive/long-running session may hold Robinhood order tools while the controller is enabled (2026-08-03: a Jul-30 interactive session placed the entry while the cron lane placed the exit - two lanes, one account, no coordination).
authority.order_gates: The single-use execution lease (minted ONLY by `make odte-convert`) + the pre-order hook are the ONLY order gates. No prose, score, label, or policy line mints or extends execution authority.

clocks.rule: THE TOOLS OWN ALL CLOCKS. The controller never computes freshness, staleness, age, or SLA arithmetic. If a tool refuses, the refusal names the clock; if no tool refused, no clock was breached.
clocks.incident: 2026-08-03 cycle 2: the controller hand-applied a remembered 60s SLA at 130s and vetoed a confirm that still had ~50s of the real 180s SLA left, without running any repo code.

sizing.rule: NO DOLLAR RAILS IN THIS FILE. Debit ceilings are BP-proportional, tiered, and computed by the repo: read `live_rails.max_debit_dollars` each tick; enforcement happens inside the lease (fractions x live BP, chase band anchor x 1.15) and the pre-order hook (lease ceilings).
sizing.incident: 2026-08-03: a compliant $125 debit was vetoed against the retired v4 $1.20 flat rail; the live ceiling was $208.90.

entry_rules.conversion: On CONFIRM_ENTRY or posture CONVERT_CANDIDATE_NOW run ONLY the fast path: (1) one batched MCP read -> write market/broker/contract snapshot JSONs with fresh as_of; (2) `make odte-convert ... JSON=1`; (3) on converted:true, review+place IMMEDIATELY consuming the lease; (4) `make odte-order-guard` poll ~10s until FILLED_FRESH or cancelled. NEVER hand-assemble confirmation/contract artifacts. NEVER run odte-entry-gate/odte-execution-authorize as a conversion path (the CLI refuses CONFIRM_ENTRY inputs with use_odte_convert).
entry_rules.stale_confirm: A stale confirm is NOT terminal. Refresh snapshots and re-run odte-convert; it re-confirms the identity in-process. Journal a terminal no_trade only when the TAPE kills the setup (odte-convert does this itself on refusal).
entry_rules.day_gate: GOOD_DAY is scan permission. CHOP is tradeable at the tier system: A+ full size, B+ half size (computed by candidate-watch from the tape; never asserted). AVOID = no entries.
entry_rules.pin_risk: Pin/gamma context is a SCORE PENALTY inside vehicle-score, not a standalone veto. If the contract still scores GOOD_BET, pin risk does not block (2026-08-03: a GOOD_BET 754C was hand-vetoed on 'high pin risk' the scorer had already priced in).
entry_rules.post_green: Re-entry after a banked green AUTO-ARMS (repo-enforced) when: daily budget slot open, cooldown passed, candidate tier >= the winning trade's tier, BP >= 1.5x contract cost. Do not add a manual green rule on top; do not refuse to scan post-green - loop-status surfaces qualifying candidates on purpose.
entry_rules.post_loss: Unchanged: after a loss, re-verify flatness/orders/BP and require an independently clean setup; no revenge sizing.

deleted_rules: b_setup_max_debit / a_setup_max_debit / a_plus_setup_max_debit (flat dollar rails - replaced by live_rails fractions)
'CHOP = A+ only' (replaced by the A+/B+ tier system)
any <=60-second confirm-to-gate/lease SLA (the live conversion SLA is repo-owned, read live_rails)
use_raw_social_files x_text.txt/reddit_text.txt/daily_thread_id.txt (files dead since 2026-07-24; missing social context must never veto a tape candidate)
affordability_is_not_edge as an entry veto (superseded by tiered BP-proportional sizing)

artifact_hygiene.rule: Cleanup runs ONLY via `make odte-cleanup` (deterministic sweep, hardcoded keep-list in src/data/odte_cleanup.py). Ad-hoc mv/archive commands against data/odte are FORBIDDEN — prose exclusion lists failed 21 times.
artifact_hygiene.note: The consumed-leases ledger materializes on the first guarded order (verified 2026-08-03); it must never be moved.

advisory_swarm.rule: ADVISORY color only, read-once when fresh (<10 min) and candidate_key matches; NEVER a gate, delay, veto, resize, retier, or reorder input. Never write under data/odte/swarm/.

reporting.eod_reconciliation: EOD numbers reconcile to the decision journal and broker fills; a day-packet postmortem that disagrees with the journal is corrected, not narrated (2026-08-03 postmortem.md double-counted the single trade as +$18).
reporting.attribution: Never narrate another lane's order as this controller's work. Order provenance = which session called review/place.
